description: Typed wrappers for Apple’s signing tools in Zuke builds: CodesignTasks (codesign), NotarytoolTasks (xcrun notarytool), SecurityTasks (security, with throwaway CI keychains) and DittoTasks (ditto). Sign and notarize macOS binaries.

Ship binaries through a Homebrew tap from a Zuke build: typed BrewTasks for the brew CLI, plus HomebrewTasks to render formulae for prebuilt binaries, verify them with the real brew, and publish them to a tap.
